name: Ark Plastics LLC
old_description: ARK Plastics LLC is a custom injection molding company that is dedicated to providing our customers with the highest quality, the best customer service, and the most competitive pricing.
about:
Ark Plastics LLC runs a custom injection molding operation from Beaver Dam, Wisconsin. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The shop houses molding machines with clamping forces ranging from 120 to 500 tons and shot capacities from 6 to 60 ounces within a 20,000-square-foot building equipped with truck and ground-level loading docks. Beyond molding, the company provides short- and long-run production, product sampling, secondary operations such as drilling and tapping, assembly, and packaging. Support services include design assistance, master unit die (MUD) programs, and custom inventory and delivery programs.

Ark Plastics primarily serves manufacturers of consumer products, offering high-quality plastic components at competitive prices. Its customer base includes businesses seeking both prototype and production quantities, though specific industry sectors beyond consumer goods are not detailed in its public information.

The company emphasizes its ability to tailor inventory and delivery schedules, provide design support, and leverage master unit die tooling to reduce lead times and tooling costs. It also promotes aggressive pricing as a core differentiator.
